text:
kevin: audit-bot flagged a spike in TLS handshake failures between apac-proxy -> eu-ingest after last night's cert rotation. seeing ~12% failures. @maria can you take a look? :eyes:

maria: on it. quick grep shows a bunch of `tls: handshake failure` in the apac-proxy logs, and nginx upstream errors 523/524. grabbing a full trace now.

jun: i pulled a sample log: `Apr 07 03:12:14 apac-proxy kube-proxy[123]: connect to eu-ingest.svc:443: tls: certificate verify failed`

maria: running openssl test from apac node to eu-ingest.
```
openssl s_client -connect eu-ingest.internal:443 -servername eu-ingest.internal -showcerts
CONNECTED(00000003)
139824... verify error:num=20:unable to get local issuer certificate
---
Certificate chain
 0 s:/CN=eu-ingest.internal
   i:/CN=redwood-rotation-ca
 1 s:/CN=redwood-rotation-ca
   i:/CN=redwood-kms-signer
---

```

maria: the chain includes a CA signed by the rotation service using a key protected in KMS. but apac proxies are failing to fetch the updated root from the cert-cache.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: cert-rotation-job v3 deployed to eu cluster @ 2003456000 by infra-automation.

lina: interesting — could be RBAC/permission to decrypt the KMS-wrapped signing key in apac. any KMS errors in control plane?

maria: yes, control-plane logs show: `AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::111222333:assumed-role/cert-rotator-apac/... is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:apac-1:111222333:key/abc-...`

kevin: that smells like a role gap. we had the cert-rotator role change last week (reduce permissions). probably missed cross-region alias.

jun: quick check: rotation job uses alias `alias/redwood-rotation-signing` (single alias with replicating keys per region). the eu key policy allows the cert-rotator-eu role, but the apac key policy doesn't include cert-rotator-apac.

maria: reproduced locally by assuming cert-rotator-apac role and running `aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://wrapped.bin --key-id alias/redwood-rotation-signing` -> AccessDeniedException.

lina: root cause: RBAC change removed kms:Decrypt for the apac role during the last permission shrink. vulnerability triage: not a cryptographic bug, but an availability/regression caused by overly aggressive least-privilege changes. severity: moderate (partial regional outage).

kevin: remediation plan: 1) add kms:Decrypt permission to cert-rotator-apac key policy and/or role IAM policy, 2) re-run rotation with a canary set in apac, 3) add audit alert if cert fetch fails >3x in 5m, 4) postmortem + runbook update. agree? :lock:

maria: ack. i'll open PR to restore the specific kms:Decrypt on the apac key policy and add cross-account alias permission.

jun: i'll do a canary rotation on two apac proxies after PR lands. will monitor TLS handshake rate and traces.

lina: i'll update the runbook to include a step to verify KMS key policies during permission shrink. also add a checklist for cross-region key aliasing.

sec-bot: incident created INC-2026-453 by lina at 2003456820.

maria: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/compare/restore-kms-apac-342 (adds explicit kms:Decrypt to cert-rotator-apac and updates key alias replication metadata). request review from @jun @kevin.

jun: reviewed and approved. applied change to apac key policy at 2003456845.

maria: re-triggered cert-rotation canary on two apac proxies. logs show successful decrypt and new cert fetched. openssl s_client now returns `Verify return code: 0 (ok)`.

kevin: rolling canary to 25% of apac proxies, watch CPU/latency and TLS fail rate.

jun: after canary, TLS handshake failures dropped to baseline (<0.5%). patch looks good.

lina: postmortem notes: root cause = overly aggressive RBAC pruning removed kms:Decrypt from apac role. Action items assigned: (1) maria -> lock PR + add cross-region key validation (due EOD), (2) jun -> add canary gating for rotation jobs (due tomorrow), (3) lina -> update runbook and add audit rule (due EOD).

kevin: also add an alert rule: if region TLS handshake errors > 2% for 5m, page sec-oncall. maria/lina to propose thresholds in config.

maria: will send proposed thresholds in #eng-sre and link to PR.

kevin: thanks all. closing this thread, will capture details in INC-2026-453 postmortem. :white_check_mark:
